verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a patent office's online services, such as batch register queries, bulk data downloads, or batch filing, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-application filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro, paper, ePCT) and search/register databases. The 'shopping cart' for goods and services is an adjacent feature for selecting classification terms within one application, not acting on many items at once, so it earns no credit.
